newsitem.title: USA: Cargill to build citric acid plant in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Cargill to build citric acid plant in Brazil.

text.p: Cargill Inc said it plans to invest $50 million to build a citric acid plant in Brazil, the company's second such facility.

The plant will be aimed at the export market with scheduled start-up in early 1999, it said in a statement. The facility will complement production at Cargill's other citric acid facility at Eddyville, Iowa.
Citric acid, a beverage and food additive, can be produced from dextrose as a byproduct from corn milling operations.
A Cargill spokesman declined comment on the capacity or location of the planned Brazilian facility.
